feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence records linking features to affected frontend files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides short summaries of numerous frontend source files including components, pages, and utilities.

frontend/src/components/AdminThemeLayout: Layout wrapper applying the selected admin theme and background effects.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Top‑level layout providing header, footer, and page structure around routed content.
frontend/src/components/AuthGate.tsx: Authentication guard that shows a loading or login-required screen when the user is not authenticated.
frontend/src/components/AuthRequiredScre: UI shown when authentication is required, providing an Internet Identity sign‑in button.
frontend/src/components/AuthStatusButton: Button that toggles between sign‑in and sign‑out actions based on authentication state.
frontend/src/components/BrandHeader.tsx: Header with navigation, branding, and responsive menu that adapts to auth and admin state.
frontend/src/components/IdCardActions.ts: Buttons for exporting or printing an ID card, with toast notifications on success or failure.
frontend/src/components/IdCardPreview.ts: Component rendering a styled preview of an ID card using provided personal data and optional photo.
frontend/src/components/IdWatermark.tsx: Empty component file placeholder for ID watermark functionality.

frontend/src/components/PhotoUploader.ts: Image uploader with drag‑and‑drop, validation, preview, and clear functionality.
frontend/src/components/StateSeal.tsx: Displays a state seal image with fallback icon behavior if the seal cannot load.
frontend/src/constants/usStates.ts: Exports a static array of U.S. state codes and names.
frontend/src/content/copy.ts: Provides static text content used across landing pages, forms, and disclaimers.

frontend/src/hooks/admin/useAdminTheme.t: Simple hook exposing the admin theme context utilities.
frontend/src/hooks/admin/useAuditLog.ts: Fetches audit log entries with polling and visibility-aware refresh behavior.
frontend/src/hooks/admin/useBulkOrderAct: Provides bulk approve, ship, and delete order mutations with query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/auth/useCallerUserPro: Fetches the current user's profile and exposes combined loading state.

frontend/src/hooks/auth/useSessionAuth.t: Empty file placeholder for session auth functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/queryKeys.ts: Defines React Query keys for orders, auth, security, and audit logs.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useAllOrders.t: Retrieves all orders for admin users, handling authorization errors.

frontend/src/hooks/orders/useDeleteOrder: Deletes an order and invalidates all order-related queries.

frontend/src/hooks/security/useSecurityS: Provides a React Query hook to fetch security stats with periodic polling when visible.

frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind-based styling, theme variables, animation utilities, and admin cyber-themed UI styles.

frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Implements the admin panel with order management, filters, bulk actions, and lazy‑loaded security and audit sections.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: User dashboard showing order list, status badges, a creation success banner, and navigation to create new orders. Handles loading state and displays empty-state messaging.

frontend/src/pages/SignInPage.tsx: Sign‑in screen using Internet Identity with status indicators and secure authentication messaging. Redirects to dashboard once logged in.
frontend/src/pages/SignUpPage.tsx: Informational page explaining Internet Identity and its benefits with a button leading to the sign‑in flow. Describes key features and onboarding expectations.
